sulla.definition:
n perennial of southern Europe cultivated for forage and for its nectar-rich pink flowers that make it an important honey crop
n Roman general and dictator (138-78 BC)

sullage.definition:
n. Drainage of filth; filth collected from the street or
   highway; sewage.
n. That which sullies or defiles.
n. The scoria on the surface of molten metal in the ladle.
n. Silt; mud deposited by water.
sullage.translation:
n. 残渣, 淤泥, 污水
[医] 污水, 污物

sullen.definition:
s showing a brooding ill humor
s darkened by clouds
sullen.translation: a. 愠怒的, 沉闷的, 阴沉的

sullenly.translation: adv. 不高兴地, 绷着脸, 忧郁地

sullenness.definition:
n a gloomy ill-tempered feeling
n a sullen moody resentful disposition
sullenness.translation: 愠怒, 闷闷不乐, （天气等）阴沉

sullied.definition:
v place under suspicion or cast doubt upon
v make dirty or spotty, as by exposure to air; also used metaphorically
v charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
sullied.translation: v. 玷污, 破坏名声( sully的过去式和过去分词 )

sullies.translation: v. 玷污, 破坏名声( sully的第三人称单数 )

sullivan.definition:
n. United States architect known for his steel framed skyscrapers and for coining the phrase `form follows function' (1856-1924)
n. United States psychiatrist (1892-1949)
n. United States host on a well known television variety show (1902-1974)
sullivan.translation: n. 沙利文, 苏利文（人名）

sullivan's test.translation: [医] 沙利文氏试验(检尿半胱氨酸)

sully.definition:
n. United States painter (born in England) of portraits and historical scenes (1783-1872)
n. French statesman (1560-1641)
sully.translation:
vt. 玷污, 弄脏
n. 污点, 脏污

sullying.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Sully
sullying.translation: v. 玷污, 破坏名声( sully的现在分词 )
